name: eval-judge
title: Eval judge
description: The judge prompt and the rubric format for eval runs: five scored items (match, composition, motion, sound, bugs) from three frames and the probes, one JSON object, the same scores for the same input. Named by the eval harness only; no class lists it.

judge.model: the served model through its image input
judge.agreement: Cohen's kappa on the human sample, reported with every run; a judge below 0.4 is not used for claims

signing: OPS-31: the system set is signed at install; the catalog key is not in the repository
